📰 XNULinux lets you run macOS on Linux without a VM

A new open-source project loads Apple’s XNU kernel as a module inside the Linux kernel, allowing the macOS desktop to run natively – no virtual machine required. The XNULinux project is open source...

📰 Source: OMG! Ubuntu
🔗 Link: https://www.omgubuntu.co.uk/2026/11/xnulinux-runs-mac-desktop-on-linux-natively
